{{Quote|--But ''my'' men didn't have any such equipment, so ''whoever'' it is-- will get to sample our ''ion-blast missiles''!|Imperial commander|<ref name="pursuit" />}}
'''Ion-blast missiles''' were weapons equipped on [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[snow flyer]]s. They had to be aimed carefully, and any disruption to the snow flyer's trajectory could cause them to miss their targets. Their blast radius was large enough that even a missed shot caused a great deal of damage and could scatter pursuers.

During the [[Mission to Akuria II]] an [[Odan (impostor)|unidentified Imperial commander]] fired an ion-blast missile from his snow flyer, scattering pursuing [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebels]] on [[power ski]]s.<ref name="pursuit" />
